# Ilderton Heating & Cooling

> Ilderton Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Ilderton, Middlesex County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (519) 666-0188  |  Email: contact@ildertonheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://ildertonheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Ilderton, London, Komoka, Kilworth, Denfield, Arva
